sourceReview.trustBoundary: CloudCompanionAuthority.apply validates the separate serialRegistry against owner, template, original pet rows and revision before the private cache accepts it; raw/imported pet metadata is stripped from read DTOs.
sourceReview.display: Only canonical decimal strings become display numbers; minimum four digits, no Number conversion, UUID or legacy serial fallback; absent metadata or identity adapter displays 待同步.
sourceReview.selector: Select value, SelectItem key/value, battle.selectPet and startTraining keep the original petId. Display roleName/instanceNumber are text only.
sourceReview.invitation: FriendsPanel passes the original pet.petId; BattleFeatureService validates that pet under the current owner and stores it in the owner-scoped invite journal. Existing wire input remains targetAccount/allowResend/actionId; display numbers do not enter the protocol.
sourceReview.persistence: Identity projection is confined to the lobby DTO; ownedPet combat DTO, original companion JSON/actions/archive, battle reports, core and protocol remain unchanged.
